Required findings: No previous gene expression profile testing performed for this diagnosis of cancer
No evidence of lymph node metastasis identified
One or more of the following adverse features identified in the surgical specimen: positive surgical margin(s), extracapsular extension, or seminal vesicle invasion
Test is being requested to inform adjuvant treatment decisions
Medical necessity indications.Source: Test Specific Guidelines > Decipher Prostate Genomic Classifier > Criteria (TOC: S3.17.6)

Non-Indications: Decipher Prostate for Biopsy is not medically necessary
Patients who have received pelvic radiation or hormone therapy prior to radical prostatectomy (RP)
Patients with detectable post-surgical PSA (above 0.2mg/dl) in the context of the specific RP criteria requiring undetectable PSA
Patients with evidence of lymph node metastasis identified in the surgical specimen
Patients who have previously undergone gene expression profile testing for the current diagnosis of cancer
Important criteria & exceptions: The inclusion of procedure code 81542 in the guideline does not imply that the code is under management or requires prior authorization; refer to the specific Health Plan's procedure code list for management requirements
NCCN guidelines recommend the Decipher molecular assay to inform adjuvant treatment if adverse features are found post-radical prostatectomy

ASCO guidelines state that commercially available molecular biomarkers may be offered in situations where the assay result, considered with routine clinical factors, is likely to affect management, but routine ordering is not recommended
Documentation required: Surgical pathology report from radical prostatectomy confirming adverse features (positive surgical margin, extracapsular extension, or seminal vesicle invasion)
Surgical pathology report confirming absence of lymph node metastasis
Laboratory results showing post-surgical PSA is undetectable (below 0.2mg/dl)
Records confirming no previous gene expression profile testing for the current diagnosis
Clinical notes indicating the test is requested to inform adjuvant treatment decisions
